thread:
maria: Heads-up — canary deploy blocked. CI failing at the helm-lint step and then e2e flakes after artifact restore. This is holding today's rollout. Anyone from infra available?

ci-bot: Pipeline #6721 failed: step 'helm-lint' exit 1. Logs attached.
```
Error: templates/: chart.go.tpl: line 45: unexpected end of file
  on templates/ingress.yaml line 12, in template:
    {{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}

```

sam: I pulled the logs — helm renders a truncated tpl. Looks like chart template got an unclosed block. Also seeing artifact-restore mismatch in the build stage (restore found digest 12345 but expected 12346). Could be cache drift from yesterday's cache sweep.

ash: I didn't touch ingress, only bumped base image in the service container, but I did tweak a helper in charts/common-helpers.tpl earlier today. Will check the tpl close tags.

jess: QA saw e2e failures tied to session-init test after a cache restore. Example excerpt: 
```
[restore] found artifact: 12345
[verify] expected artifact: 12346
[error] artifact digest mismatch, falling back to rebuild
```
That mismatch sometimes causes the session-expiry e2e to fail if the built binary differs.

ben: This aligns with the cache TTL sweep at 03:10UTC — some nodes pulled new layers while others served older ones. Shared build cache + non-deterministic toolchain can cause digest skew.

maria: Options: 1) hold and revert chart helper change 2) pin chart-utils dependency to previous version 3) run a clean build (no cache) to prove it's cache-related. We need one-liner decision — low-risk path preferred.

sam: I can trigger a manual pipeline with CLEAN_CACHE=true to validate. If that fixes both helm-lint and e2e, we treat it as cache drift. If helm-lint still fails it's a real template bug. I'll run it in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy aborted for commit abcdef (pipeline_failure).

ash: Running local helm lint now. Reproduced the error — missing closing tag on charts/common-helpers.tpl around the conditional. Looks like my change introduced it. Sorry, my bad. Pushing a tiny fix now.

maria: If the fix takes >30m we should consider rolling back to v2.3.1 to keep the change window. Which is faster: hotfix chart patch or rollback?

jess: QA can validate a hotfix canary quickly if you trigger the pipeline with CLEAN_CACHE=true after the fix. If it's green, we can avoid rollback.

ash: Pushed fix (PR #482): closed the template block and added a tiny unit test for the helper. Also creating a parallel PR that pins chart-utils to 1.3.2 as a defensive change. Triggering build with CLEAN_CACHE=true now.

ci-bot: Pipeline #6722 started by ash (CLEAN_CACHE=true). Steps: checkout -> build -> helm-lint -> e2e.

sam: Also filing a quick hotfix to Chart.yaml to pin chart-utils to 1.3.2 in case of weird rendering differences. Low-risk and reversible.

ben: For release notes: include note about "hotfix: chart template fix and pinned chart-utils to avoid intermittent lint failures and cache drift". Also follow-up item to audit cache TTL and rebuild determinism.

maria: Sounds good. Keep this thread updated. If e2e still flakes after CLEAN_CACHE we rollback. :hourglass:

ci-bot: Pipeline #6722 succeeded. helm-lint OK. build artifact digest consistent. e2e passed.

jess: QA run against canary passed all tests. Approving canary promotion.

deploy-bot: Promoting canary abcdef -> prod (requested by maria).

maria: Moving forward with release. Thanks everyone — creating a follow-up ticket to audit shared cache TTL, add a deterministic-build checklist, and include an automated helm-lint check in the pre-merge CI to catch tpl syntax early.

ash: Sorry for the noise, will be more careful with chart helpers.

maria: Closing — release proceeding. :white_check_mark:
